{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Blood}}
[[File:Ponda_Babas_arm.png|thumb|right|280px|A freshly severed [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] arm draining blood.]]
{{Quote|The average humanoid adult has a blood volume of approximately four-point-nine liters, of which two-point-seven liters is plasma. Humanoid survival with an untreated Class Four blood loss&mdash;that is, greater than forty percent of total volume&mdash;is unlikely for more than a few minutes. The amount of blood soaked into this carpet is, I estimate, nearly three liters. Even if the deceased had recently spent some months at an altitude sufficient to have radically thickened his blood, his red cell count could not be sufficient to allow survival with such a volumetric loss.|[[I-5YQ]], on the stabbing death of [[Ves Volette]]|<ref name="Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>}}
'''Blood''' was a bodily fluid that many [[Species/Legends|species]] had. It provided a way for the body to transport [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]], nutrients, waste and other things vital to survival over the body. The [[Color/Legends|color]] of blood varied between species. Most species, including [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]], [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabraks]], and [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] had red blood. [[Duros/Legends|Duros]], [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], and [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] had green blood. [[T'surr (species)|T'surr]], [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]], [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]], and [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] had blue blood. [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] had yellow blood. [[Judd's species]], [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]], [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]], [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]],<ref name="cross">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref> and [[Yuuzhan Vong]] had black blood.

According to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], the taste of blood was roughly equivalent to the taste of liquid [[Tin/Legends|tin]].<ref name="JediSearch">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref> A blood transfusion from a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] to a non-Force sensitive would not grant the latter a connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> In [[3645 BBY]], [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] and [[Sith alchemist/Legends|alchemist]] [[Darth Scabrous]] used a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]]-mounted intravenous device to transplant uncontaminated blood when [[Gender/Legends|he]] was infected by a [[Zombie/Legends|zombie]]-creating virus known as "[[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|the Sickness]]." This slowed the rate of transformation, allowing him to survive much longer than others who were infected.<ref name="RH">[[Red Harvest (novel)|''Red Harvest'']]</ref>

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Blood is occasionally visible in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' films. In [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] has blood stains on his shirt when he is stabbed by [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and a brief splatter of atomized blood can be seen when [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] cleaves Darth Maul. In [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], Obi-Wan has blood on him after [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] cuts his arms and legs, though these may be burns since [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] tend to cauterize flesh. In [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], blood can be seen inside the canisters of the [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] is receiving medical treatment after losing the [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|duel]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] against Obi-Wan. In [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], [[Ponda Baba/Legends|Ponda Baba]] lost his arm to Obi-Wan's [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's third lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], which produced a trail of blood. Following that, every subsequent time a limb is amputated on-screen or a wound of any kind is inflicted by a lightsaber, the lightsaber flash-cauterizes the wound, resulting in little to no blood loss or any visible blood. With each instance of mutilation, dismemberment, punctures, or other wounds scene in the ''Star Wars'' series, little to no hemorrhaging or gore can be seen, with [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] getting scratched by a [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]], [[Cordé/Legends|Cordé's]] bloody figure, and the bloody wounds on [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]] being some of the last instances of blood in the ''Star Wars'' series. It was only until the ''Clone Wars'' series and ''Revenge of the Sith'' did blood and gore become truly absent from the series, with the exception of Anakin's burnt, mutilated figure after his defeat by Obi Wan. Also, usual deaths on ''Star Wars'' will include wounds that are cauterized or burned, with any bloody or gory injuries being shown on screen.
